overview.description: The VistaShares Robotics Supercycle ETF (RTOO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in robotics companies worldwide. It uses the BITA VistaShares Robotics Supercycle Index as its baseline for portfolio selection and weighting. RTOO was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by VistaShares.
